headline.text: L1 S3 temper dropped out of range at 12:30 and L2 ML2 fought broken bars and blow-offs *most of 3rd shift* — both lines now stabilizing.

per_plant_summary.L1: Four lines ran caramel cluster with steady output. S1 cleared a metal detector jam and several hardware fixes (shaker nut, blue tab screw) before noon. S3 hit enrober pressure issues mid-shift and temper fell out of range late — line stopped at 12:30 to recover. S4 fought a conbar belt peeling issue that's still open.
per_plant_summary.L2: FFS ran through print mark and seal issues most of the day but stayed on rate. ML2 had the roughest shift: long belts replaced on 2nd, then 3rd shift spent hours troubleshooting broken bars and blow-offs — issue cleared by 08:07 after nozzle cleaning. Caramel tank water pump is failing but still holding temp. ML3 ran clean.
per_plant_summary.L3: Truffle line reported a damaged belt at 06:17 with no follow-up. ML4 is deep in commissioning — cold stamp and nozzle plates failed micro tests and are being re-cleaned. ML1 and MF Matrix both ran well; MF Matrix dialed in an 11oz pouch recipe mid-shift.

notes.text: Kitchen 1 floor left dirty by 2nd shift at shift change — 3rd shift lead escalated for coaching.
Walk Global pallet confusion for PriceMart order resolved after photo comparison; spec will be updated with identifying image.
Crisp countdown tool added to supervisor toolkit on the S-drive.
Grey posted updated kitchen tank emptying plan for Saturday changeover — stop adding chocolate at 11:00 instead of noon to account for trim remelt.

resolved.title: Washer fell into pouch from M10 cone
resolved.summary: X-ray inspection caught washer inside pouch during check; operator had cleaned M10 cone but didn't replace washer properly, causing it to fall into product.
resolved.resolution: X-ray detected and rejected the pouch; washer secured back on M10 cone at 14:46 (Mariela Gudino).

resolved.title: Cereal loader not opening properly
resolved.summary: Loader not opening on S1, likely overfilled and blocking up; operators emptying loader before bed thins out.
resolved.resolution: Operators emptied loader; issue resolved shortly after 22:27 (Conner Boyd).

resolved.title: S4 C2 kettle lid leaking air
resolved.summary: Second batch won't send up due to air leak on kettle lid, maintenance working on it.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance tightened lid and fixed leak; batch started up at 04:27 (S4 Kitchen Tablet).

resolved.title: Metal detector not opening on S1
resolved.summary: MD reading cards correctly but not opening; significant buildup on MD may be blocking operation, maintenance waiting for area to be cleaned.
resolved.resolution: Production cleaned MD and maintenance adjusted belt; test cards read and MD opened properly at 08:19 (Mariela Gudino, Katya Farnsworth).

resolved.title: Hair found in product before enrober
resolved.summary: Operator found hair on west side of conveyor just before enrober; QA and depositor operator notified, all employees coached to wear two hats and secure hair.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 15:48 — employees coached on double hats and hair restraint (Delia Zambrano).

resolved.title: M9 pouch shaker nut missing
resolved.summary: First shift found shaker piece missing the nut that secures it; operator reported it tightened during her previous shift.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance replaced nut and secured it at 07:51 (Mariela Gudino).

resolved.title: Hopper sensor affected by sun reflection
resolved.summary: Hopper not filling properly because sensor affected by sun reflection through window; temporary cardboard barriers were removed.
resolved.resolution: Temporary barriers replaced to block sunlight from sensor; issue resolved and running at 09:07 (Marcos Jimenez).

resolved.title: M10 blue tab missing screw and nut
resolved.summary: Blue tab on M10 not installed correctly, missing screw and nut, was force-fitted and doesn't fit properly.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance adjusted part and installed missing screw and nut at 10:45 (Mariela Gudino).

resolved.title: Bottomer exposing parts on S1
resolved.summary: Bottomer needs adjustment because several chocolate pieces have exposed bottoms.
resolved.resolution: Leader adjusted the bottomer by 09:03 (Mariela Gudino, S1 Enrober).

resolved.title: FFS bags cutting badly at 14:10
resolved.summary: Machine down because mars cutting bags badly; maintenance reset machine.
resolved.resolution: Machine reset; production started at 15:00 (VFFS).

resolved.title: ML3 air rejector throwing everything away
resolved.summary: Line down since 17:40, air rejector having issues and rejecting all product.
resolved.resolution: Line running again at 17:49 (Molding Line 3 Pack).

resolved.title: ML2 VideoJet printer stopped at 20:01
resolved.summary: Line stopped because VideoJet printer stopped; no product without lot code was packed.
resolved.resolution: Mixing tank needed to be primed; printer cleared and line running at 20:28 (Brandon Lance).

resolved.title: ML2 broken bars and blow-offs through 3rd shift
resolved.summary: Bars breaking at demolder due to cold chocolate; extensive troubleshooting of vacuum belt, sensors, centerlines, and demolder settings through 3rd shift.
resolved.resolution: Operator removed nozzles and cleaned between nozzles during CIL; no more broken bars by 08:07 (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: FFS long seal not sealing every pouch at 06:49
resolved.summary: Long seal failing to seal every pouch after line start; Cy adjusting.
resolved.resolution: Adjusting pressure on long seal remedied the problem at 07:04 (Jeffrey Barney).

resolved.title: FFS pouches not sealing, no air retention at 08:53
resolved.summary: Pouches not completely sealing and don't contain air after batch change; Justin working on adjustments.
resolved.resolution: Moved long seal 2mm and tightened side belts after cleaning; line up at 09:10 (Jeffrey Barney).

resolved.title: ML2 Sweco screen had rice buildup
resolved.summary: Tempering stopped to change Sweco screen which had rice buildup; appears PTL to Sweco flush was not done.
resolved.resolution: Sweco screen changed; new screen passed ATP at 18:27 (Wilson Amaris Cabrera).

resolved.title: ML2 belt after curve coming loose
resolved.summary: Section of belt after curve starting to detach, could compromise product safety; monitoring while production continues.
resolved.resolution: Belt replaced by maintenance and passed ATP test at 22:33 (Fernando Flores, Jose Cabrera).

resolved.title: ML3 printer problem at 05:42
resolved.summary: Printer having problems, maintenance fixing.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 05:45 (Molding Line 3 Pack).

resolved.title: MF Matrix no recipe for 11oz pouch
resolved.summary: Setting up 11oz pouch but no recipe exists in Yamato or checkweigher; machine set up with pouch and code but needs recipe created.
resolved.resolution: Recipes created on MFM, checkweight, and x-ray at 06:42 (Nathan Ruiz).

resolved.title: Truffle kitchen turbotemper temp out of range
resolved.summary: Kitchen turbotemper temperature outside acceptable range at 09:02, maintenance notified.
resolved.resolution: Glycol tank low causing air pockets; topped off glycol, verified pressure, temp rising to setpoint at 10:14 (Nathan Ruiz).

needs_attention.title: S1 scale causing accumulation and pauses
needs_attention.summary: Scale issues causing lots of accumulation, line paused at 02:27 while maintenance investigates.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance looking at scale as of 02:27; no update posted by end of window.

needs_attention.title: S3 temper out of range, line stopped at 12:30
needs_attention.summary: Temper fell out of range; line stopped to bring temper back within spec.
needs_attention.status: Line stopped at 12:30, working to bring temper back in range; no follow-up by window close.

needs_attention.title: S1 chiller amperage spike under investigation
needs_attention.summary: Meter installed to monitor chiller breaker trips; meter shows amperage spike indicating chiller problem, not breaker.
needs_attention.status: Matt will discuss next steps with Sollich vendor on-site today; meter confirmed chiller issue at 10:25.

needs_attention.title: S4 conbar belt scraping and peeling
needs_attention.summary: Conbar belt getting scraped and peeling; maintenance notified to investigate what's causing the damage.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance notified at 08:44; no resolution posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: S3 enrober return pipe pressure climbing
needs_attention.summary: Return pipe pressure from enrober at 5.3 bar and rising; maintenance recommends increasing screw drive temp and manual purge every 5-10 minutes.
needs_attention.status: Screw drive temp increased from 29°C to 32°C; operators doing manual purge every 5-10 minutes as of 11:05.

needs_attention.title: S2 CPK order done but 5 pallets need labels
needs_attention.summary: CPK production order completed but 5 pallets still need labels applied.
needs_attention.status: 5 pallets waiting for labels as of 11:55.

needs_attention.title: FFS print mark detection recurring
needs_attention.summary: Still having issues with print mark not being detected; problem mentioned multiple times through 2nd and 3rd shifts.
needs_attention.status: Lance called back at 04:28 for ongoing print mark issues; recurring throughout window with no permanent fix.

needs_attention.title: ML2 caramel tank water pump failing
needs_attention.summary: Water pump not circulating and making loud noise; no spare pumps available, checking with L1 for spare; tank 65% full and holding temp.
needs_attention.status: Pump failing but tank holding temp at 65% full as of 02:44; plan to run out caramel before swapping tanks.

needs_attention.title: Truffle line damaged belt reported
needs_attention.summary: Damaged belt reported at 06:17, maintenance notified; operators left area organized for 1st shift.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance notified of damaged belt at 06:17; no follow-up or resolution posted in window.

needs_attention.title: ML4 cold stamp plate failed 3 micro tests
needs_attention.summary: Cold stamp plate failed all 3 rounds of environmental testing; needs re-clean before commissioning can proceed.
needs_attention.status: Plates re-cleaned, dried, and swabbed; results pending as of 10:55.

needs_attention.title: ML4 nozzle plate failed micro tests
needs_attention.summary: Nozzle plates had issues during environmental testing; not as bad as cold stamp but need re-clean.
needs_attention.status: Nozzle plates disassembled, re-cleaned, and passed ATP at 10:04; environmental test underway.
